content.text: Each named student has exactly one matching invoice, and the three sum to the amount.

input.rationale: Lender disbursal names Ishaan Joshi, Krishna Naik, Aditya Ghosh. Their open invoices INV-00213 (50,00,000), INV-00214 (90,00,000), INV-00215 (45,00,000) sum exactly to 1,85,00,000 paise. Other subsets that sum correctly involve customers not named (Ishaan Ghosh, Nisha Naik, Sneha Naik, Arjun Ghosh), so they are invalid.
